name: 33538-decodeheavy-8b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1. One card; the 8.2B bf16 checkpoint is 16.4 GB and needs no sharding.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=800, bounded at 2000 requests / 1800 s safety, with 10% warmup and 10% cooldown margins declared.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix buckets. Prompt pinned at exactly 128 tokens and output at exactly 512 (min = max, ignore_eos), seed 32558. Sampling is declared in scenario.json -- temperature 0.6, top_k 20, top_p 0.95, the three values in this checkpoint's own generation_config.json.
purpose: An 8-billion-parameter chat assistant writing long-form replies from short prompts for 800 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# Engine command line for commit dc5fa77a4eb6680339cb77abe713fb22d7795560.
# Interpreter and hardware seal: configs/env.yaml (NOT portable, per-machine).

model: Qwen/Qwen3-8B

tensor-parallel-size: 1

max-model-len: 2048

# LOAD-BEARING, DO NOT DELETE AS "A DEFAULT": the default at this commit is 128, below the
# declared 800 requests in flight, and a scheduler width under that silently caps the running set.
max-num-seqs: 1024

max-num-batched-tokens: 8192

gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90

enable-prefix-caching: false

enable-chunked-prefill: true

dtype: bfloat16
